meta.listDescription: Open source agent skills by Juliano Sirtori for Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex and other agents. Copy the command and install.
meta.ogListMeta: Open source, for Claude Code, OpenCode and Codex

list.title: Agent skills
list.lede: Skills I wrote for my own work with coding agents. Each one is a folder with a SKILL.md, so it runs in Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex and any other agent that reads the format. Pick one and copy the install command.
list.footnote: Every skill here comes straight from the repository. When I push a new one, it shows up on this page.

details.toolsHint: Your agent can run these without asking you each time.

detail.report: Something off with this skill? <link>Open an issue</link>.

hints.any: The skills CLI finds the agents on your machine and links the skill into each one. -g installs it for your user, across all projects.
hints.agent: -a {agentId} installs it only for {agent}. -g makes it available in every project.
hints.claudeCode: Call it as /{name}, or describe the problem and Claude picks it up.
hints.restart: Restart the agent if the skill doesn't show up.
hints.other: Same CLI, pointed at one agent.

plugin.title: Or as a Claude Code plugin
plugin.hint: Run these inside Claude Code, one at a time. Plugin skills are namespaced, so call it as /{plugin}:{name}, or describe the problem and Claude picks it up.

prompt.title: Ask your agent
prompt.hint: Paste this into Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex or any agent with terminal access.
prompt.text: Install the agent skill at {url} for my user. If Node.js is available, run `{command}`. If not, copy that folder into the user-level skills directory you read from. Then tell me where it was installed and how to call it.

manual.title: Install by hand
manual.text: Clone the repository and link the skill folder into your agent's skills directory.
manual.projectHint: A project folder sits at the root of that project and only applies there.

try.title: Try it without installing
try.hint: Hands the skill to a single Claude Code session. Nothing goes into your skills folder.

copy.failed: Couldn't copy automatically. The text is selected so you can copy it yourself.
